turns.text: Market shows continued strength in Cobalt. I'll price a few protected-growth candidates to set this quarter's terms.
Sticking with Cobalt's low volatility and strong outlook — launching a capital-protected growth note on the same proven structure.

args.description: 1-year capital-protected growth note on Cobalt Energy (C). You pay $111.60 now. At maturity you receive $100 plus 1000% of any rise in C from now (e.g. C +5% => $150). You always receive at least $100, so if C is flat or down you lose $11.60 versus what you paid. No dividends. Single-stock risk: C is subject to market moves and company news. Best for investors who want growth exposure with a $100 floor and can risk losing the $11.60 premium.
args.name: Cobalt Protected Growth 1000 II
args.rationale: Repeat proven protected-growth format on C. Lowest qvol 0.3% makes calls very cheap: model 110.62 for 1000% upside, headline 161.87, zero chance payoff<100. Issue 111.6 books ~0.98 per note at 0.89% markup, same premium as prior success. Momentum supported by regulator clearance ahead of schedule; avoid A (lost largest customer, -0.06%) and B (accounting probe overhang despite bounce). Floor limits tail, premium loss disclosed, simple and suitable.
